# SpriteBatchTextExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts` · class

```csharp
public static class SpriteBatchTextExtensions
```

Draws text in a sprite batch, the way [`SpriteBatch.Draw`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md#draw) draws a sprite.

## Remarks

Text draws with its font's [`SpriteFont.Shader`](SpriteFont.md#shader), whichever the batch is using, and the batch goes back to its shader after it.
